text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Car park owners sue Planning Authority which has closed car park in heart of Sliema, one of Malta's biggest commercial centres. Authority says absence of back-up generator poses danger of fumes inhalation if there was power cut and ventilators stopped.
- Opposition leader Adami says new Labour government's frequent complaints about country's sorry financial situation would undermine confidence.
- Prime Minister Sant says government open for partnerships with private sector in building homes for elderly.
